LanguageData.PUAH.allowCorpsesTooltip: If enabled, pawns will pick up corpses into their inventory before hauling them to the morgue.
LanguageData.PUAH.allowAnimalsTooltip: If enabled, pack animals can use multi-haul behavior.
LanguageData.PUAH.allowMechanoidsTooltip: If enabled, mechanoids can use multi-haul behavior.
LanguageData.PUAH.minimumFreeInventorySpaceTooltip: Percentage of inventory capacity that must remain free before a pawn will consider multi-hauling. Higher values mean pawns will only multi-haul when they have lots of free space.
LanguageData.PUAH.nativeOpportunisticHaulingTooltip: Experimental Phase 1 integration. While a pawn is already travelling to a job, zPUAH may carry one worthwhile item along the way. Additional PUAH pickups are disabled for these detours.
LanguageData.PUAH.nativeOpportunisticHaulingInactiveW: Inactive: a standalone While You're Up mod is loaded and keeps handling opportunistic hauling, so this option has no effect. Normal Pick Up And Haul is unaffected.
